title: fsimb: code and results for "Evaluating feature selection for high-dimensional imbalanced data: leakage, resampling, and the strength of simple minority-aware filters"
description: Code, result files and analysis scripts for a benchmark of feature selection on high-dimensional class-imbalanced data (34 discovery datasets, 18 pre-registered held-out datasets and Dorothea). Includes nested evaluation with label-permutation leakage runs, filters, embedded methods, wrappers, evolutionary multitasking, re-implementations of MF-CSO and sssHD, and the scripts that rebuild every table and figure of the manuscript from the stored results.
